raid.title: Check Most Used Party Statistics
raid.description:
Referring to stable parties that are moderately popular
can help you achieve Platinum more easily.

popover.title: 1. View Detailed Parties
popover.description: Move to the tab where you can see detailed party statistics.

popover.title: 2. Frequently Deployed Formations
popover.description: This tab allows you to check the most commonly used party combinations.

popover.title: 3. Change to All Types
popover.description:
Change the options to check overall party statistics
regardless of attack or defense types.

popover.title: 4. View Party Details
popover.description:
List of parties sorted by usage frequency.
Click each party to view detailed statistics.

popover.title: 5. View Student Details
popover.description:
Click a student icon to see growth statistics for that student,
such as average star level and Unique Weapon level.

popover.title: 6. Other Information
popover.description:
Check detailed operational information such as
fixed starting skills and student deployment order.

raid.title: Check Assistant Statistics
raid.description:
Check students with high demand
that are good to set as Circle Assistants.

popover.title: 1. View Detailed Parties
popover.description: Move to the tab where you can see detailed party statistics.

popover.title: 2. Check Participation Rate
popover.description: This tab shows the overall participation rate for each student.

popover.title: 3. View Assistants Only
popover.description:
Click the button to see statistics only for students
most frequently used as Assistants (Rentals).

raid.title: Search for Custom Condition Parties
raid.description:
Exclude specific students or search only for parties using desired students
to reduce investment costs.

popover.title: 1. View Detailed Parties
popover.description: Move to the tab where you can see detailed party statistics.

popover.title: 2. Set Rank Range for Statistics
popover.description:
Set the rank range for generating statistics.

By specifying START and END values,
you can view data aggregated only from users in that range.

popover.title: 3. Check Rankings & Teams
popover.description:
Shows the actual clear rankings and parties of users in order.
You can filter for specific conditions using the filter function on the right.

popover.title: 4. Select Students to Include/Deploy
popover.description:
Search or select students to include in the formation.
(Supports English name search for JP/Hant users)

You can precisely set whether a student must be included in the party
and the desired star level (e.g., 3★ to UE50).

popover.title: 5. Set Excluded Students / Assistants
popover.description:
Set students you do not own or cannot deploy due to lack of growth.

• Completely Exclude: Remove entirely from the party list.
• Assistant Available: Include in search only if borrowed once from others.

common.title: Estimate Rank/Score based on Past JP Data (Common)
common.description:
Check your score and expected rank based on past JP server data.
You can gauge whether achieving Platinum is possible in the current Total/Grand Assault.

popover.title: 1. View Overall Score Distribution
popover.description: Move to the tab where you can check the score distribution of all users.

popover.title: 2. Record Lookup Area
popover.description: This area allows you to search past JP server data based on your records.

popover.title: 3. Detailed Record Search
popover.description:
Enter your clear score, remaining time, or target JP rank.
You can immediately check historical records and rank cut-offs from the JP server.

jukebox.title: Find BGM Usage
jukebox.description:
Search for where a specific BGM was used in-game
or which BGM played during a specific story.

popover.title: 1. Select Spoiler Filter
popover.description:
Select the story range to search.
As search results may include the latest stories released only on the JP server,
searches are performed only within the designated range to prevent spoilers.
(Press the 'Select All' button to select the entire range at once.)

popover.title: 2. Search BGM
popover.description: Quickly search for your desired BGM by track title or composer name.

popover.title: 3. View Detailed Information
popover.description:
Click 'Expand Details' to see where the BGM is used within your spoiler filter range.

Click 'Expand All' to display all information at once,
or toggle 'Show Story Title' to see specific story names.

jukebox.title: Random Loop BGM Playback
jukebox.description:
Randomly and continuously plays in-game BGMs.
(Played via YouTube player; YouTube Premium or ad-blocking extensions are recommended for uninterrupted listening.)

popover.title: 1. Select Playback Range (Spoiler) Filter
popover.description:
To prevent spoilers, only BGMs within the designated range are included in the playback pool.
You can select all tracks at once, but be aware it may include spoiler tracks from the latest stories.

popover.title: 2. Start Random Play
popover.description:
Click the button to randomly play BGMs within the selected range.
(Playback may temporarily stop if a track without linked YouTube video information is selected.)

heatmap.title: Where will this student shine?
heatmap.description:
Check which boss battles a specific student is frequently used in.
Useful for deciding whether to recruit (Gacha) or invest Eligma into a student.

popover.title: 1. Search Student to Analyze
popover.description:
Search and select the name of the student whose statistics you want to check.
(Supports English name/Romaji search.)

popover.title: 2. Select Difficulty
popover.description:
Select the boss difficulty (e.g., Insane, Torment) to display
deployment statistics specifically for that difficulty.

popover.title: 3. Recruitment Statistics Summary
popover.description:
Shows the pick rate and the star levels at which
the student was used in each Total and Grand Assault.

popover.title: 4. Star Level Filtering & Heatmap Preparation
popover.description:
Use the heatmap below to see deployment rates by boss and season at a glance.
(※ Recommended for wide PC or tablet screens.)

First, set the star level range to be displayed on the heatmap.

popover.title: 5. Select All Star Levels
popover.description: Click the 'Select All' button to include data for all star levels at once.

popover.title: 6. View Heatmap Details
popover.description:
A heatmap of deployment rates for all seasons based on your conditions will appear.
Click a specific cell (season) in the graph to view more detailed statistics for that boss battle.

ranking.title: Future Sight Total/Grand Assault Student Usage Ranking
ranking.description:
Check which students were most frequently deployed in upcoming seasons
and the average star level at which they were primarily used.

popover.title: 1. Select Inquiry Period
popover.description: Move the slider bar at the top to select the period (season range) to view data.

popover.title: 2. Check Comprehensive Ranking
popover.description:
View the overall ranking and star level distribution of students
who were deployed most frequently during the selected period.

ranking.title: Specific Difficulty (Torment, etc.) Student Deployment Ranking
ranking.description:
Check in detail which students were primarily used and at what star level
for specific high difficulties like 'Torment' or 'Insane'.

popover.title: 1. Select Difficulty to Analyze
popover.description: Select the specific difficulty (e.g., Torment) you wish to analyze from the filter.

popover.title: 2. Select Inquiry Period
popover.description: Move the slider bar at the top to set the period (season range) to view data.

popover.title: 3. Check Detailed Ranking
popover.description:
Confirm the student deployment rankings and detailed star level ratios
corresponding to the selected period and difficulty.

favor.title: What's the Most Used Profile Picture?
favor.description:
Check interesting statistics on which profile pictures
top-tier Total/Grand Assault users use the most.

popover.title: 1. Change Title Type
popover.description: Set the title type to 'Profile Picture' in the dropdown menu.

popover.title: 2. Sort Ranking
popover.description:
Click the table header to sort data by total usage frequency
or by recent changes (increase/decrease).

favor.title: Relationship 100 Title Ranking & Trending Titles
favor.description:
Inquire into Relationship 100 title equipment statistics
to see which students are the most loved.

popover.title: 1. Change Title Type
popover.description: Set the title type to 'Relationship 100 Title' in the dropdown menu.

popover.title: 2. Sort Rankings and Trends
popover.description:
Click the table header to view by overall rank
or sort by change to find titles that have recently surged in popularity.

event.title: Check Report and Enhancement Stone Purchase Efficiency
event.description:
Compare AP efficiency when purchasing Reports and Enhancement Stones from the event shop.

However, since repeating event stages has a low probability of dropping Top-tier Outfits, farming stages might be more advantageous than shop purchases if you are low on Outfits.

popover.title: Move to Bonus Tab
popover.description: If you haven't set up student bonuses yet, please move to the Bonus tab.

popover.title: Select Bonus Students
popover.description:
Click the icons of the students you own.
AP efficiency is calculated based on the bonus values of the selected students.

popover.title: Move to Goal Setting
popover.description: Move to the Goal Setting tab and click 'Shop' in the detailed goals.

popover.title: Convert to AP Unit
popover.description: Converts the prices of shop items into AP units based on the currently applied bonus values.

popover.title: Check Efficiency Labels
popover.description:
Efficiency based on the Special Mission 2x event is displayed together.

(Note: During the Special Mission 3x event period, you can compare by multiplying this value by 1.5. However, usually it is more beneficial to directly run Special Missions during the 3x period.)

popover.title: Check Item Efficiency
popover.description:
Check the purchase efficiency based on the converted AP value.
If the desired item is not there, you can switch to another shop by clicking the tabs at the top.

event.title: Calculate AP Needed for Full Shop Purchase
event.description: Calculate the total AP and amount of currency needed to purchase all items in the event shop, and set up an optimal farming plan.

popover.title: Check Currency Minimap
popover.description:
The excess or shortage status of event currency is displayed on this minimap.
Use this information to establish an overall farming plan.

popover.title: Move to Bonus Tab
popover.description: First, move to the Bonus tab for accurate calculation.

popover.title: Select Bonus Students
popover.description:
Select the students you own to apply the bonus values.
Based on this, the required currency amount and efficiency will be calculated.

popover.title: Move to Goal Setting
popover.description:
Move to the Goal Setting tab and click 'Shop'.
Check each shop tab and select the items you aim for.

popover.title: Select All Items
popover.description:
Click 'Purchase All Items' to proceed with the guide.
(Clicking the button that immediately skips to the next step also automatically selects all items.)

popover.title: Mini-game Settings (Optional)
popover.description:
If there are mini-games like prize exchanges or Omikuji, you can run simulations here.

Pressing the 'Max' button automatically sets the target currency amount based on shop requirements.
Click the simulation run button to calculate approximate probabilities and efficiency, then move to the next step.

popover.title: Move to AP Supply Tab
popover.description: Move to the Supply tab to calculate the total AP required.

popover.title: Set AP Supply Amount
popover.description:
Calculate the amount of AP naturally supplied during the event period.
The default schedule is set based on the Japanese server, but you can change it to the global server schedule using the shortcut.

popover.title: Move to Farming Settings Tab
popover.description: Move here to set which stages to farm for currency.

popover.title: Set Recurring Farming
popover.description: Set the currency that can be repeatedly obtained from event quest stages.

popover.title: First Clear Rewards
popover.description: Choose whether to include rewards given only once for the first clear and 3-star clear in the result simulator.

popover.title: Set First Rewards (Story/Challenge)
popover.description: This is where you add rewards for stages that can only be cleared once, such as story or challenge stages.

popover.title: Apply Clearing Each Once
popover.description: Similarly, click this button to collectively add the rewards for the first clear and 3-star achievement of those stages to the calculator.

popover.title: Execute Farming Calculation
popover.description:
Calculate the optimal farming route that consumes minimum AP based on the selected items.
By default, it is set to farm high-efficiency stages (Stages 9-12, etc.), which can be adjusted in the options below.

Usually, the calculation result will show a shortage of AP. Now, let's go back to the previous tab to resolve this.

popover.title: Back to AP Supply Tab
popover.description: Move back to the Supply tab to replenish the lacking AP.

popover.title: Set Lacking AP Recharge
popover.description: If you lack the AP required for farming, you can set a plan to recharge AP using Pyroxenes or Tactical Challenge Coins here to meet the shortage.
